I5.quote: Metal organic frameworks (MOFs) are a class of porous organic-inorganic crystalline materials that have attracted much attention as H2 storage devices and catalytic supports.

notes: Catalysis paper: Ni nanoparticles from pyrolysed Ni-MOF-74 tested in liquid-phase olefin hydrogenation (main p. 5-6, Table 2). Only gas-sorption data are N2 isotherms at -196 C (BET, Table 1; alpha_s, Table S1). TPD (main p. 2, SI Figure S2) records gases released on heating the MOF, not H2 uptake. The '& Electrocatalysts' banner on p. 1 is a journal section label; no electrochemistry is performed, so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated, not electrochemical or theoretical_only. Primary research article; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF; no duplicate-data statement.
